description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipDecorator class which extends functionality for the EmployeeMembership entity within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to set relationships and retrieve formatted data related to employee memberships.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeMembership providing additional methods to manipulate and retrieve related data in a formatted way.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeMembership entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee reference in EmployeeMembership based on employee number.

methods.name: setMembershipByMembershipId
methods.description: Sets the Membership reference in EmployeeMembership based on membership ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCommenceDate
methods.description: Retrieves the subscription commence date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getSubscriptionRenewalDate
methods.description: Retrieves the subscription renewal date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getCurrencyName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the subscription currency using the PayGradeService.
